mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have foggy conditions across the city, including right here at Verona Area High School, with temperatures sitting at 58 degrees.

The city is moving forward with two major infrastructure projects. Mark Drive is currently in Phase 2 of reconstruction, focusing on utility work and road improvements. Additionally, the city is reviewing rehabilitation projects for streets like Gateway Pass and Enterprise Drive to ensure our roadways remain in safe, functional condition.

We have a busy day ahead in Verona! Today, you can visit the downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, attend the UGM event at Epic Systems, enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness, grab pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, or participate in trivia night at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead to tomorrow, check out the free Concerts in the Park at Century School Park or Hop Haus trivia.
For our weekly report, on Friday, officers stopped a vehicle near North Main Street and Cross Country Road and arrested the driver for an O W I after she was found passed out behind the wheel.
Today's delicious flavor is Double Strawberry. Culver's is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM. If you miss out, tomorrow's flavor is Chocolate Heath Crunch.
